name: page-model-card-parity
goal: Page Models use unchanged catalog cards and exclude type collections at every revision

evidence: 428eac5a6 introduced context-specific footer suppression. Existing registry category also treats .types collections as models, exposed by new transitive page dependencies. Preserve source names and categorize type collections separately.

Existing category and Page Models tests accepted kind=model alone and checked only model link text. Extend the normal shared fixture with paired Order and Order.types, compare complete catalog/relationship cards, and exercise footer previews at current/historical revisions and all viewports.
